name: Jorge Thielen Armand
bio: Jorge Thielen Armand is a director, screenwriter and film producer. His third feature, Death Has No Master, starring Asia Argento, premiered at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival Directors' Fortnight and is Venezuela's official submission for Best International Feature at the 99th Academy Awards. His earlier work includes La Soledad (Venice Film Festival, 2016), La Fortaleza (International Film Festival Rotterdam, 2020), and Pasta Negra (Sundance, 2025). He is a founding partner of La Faena, a production company based in Caracas and Toronto. In 2021 he was awarded the Guggenheim Fellowship.

credits.title: Of Memory and Debris
credits.overview: A personal portrait of the director’s grandfather Opa, and his wife's grandfather Ababo, who remained in Venezuela after most of their family emigrated due to the economic crisis and violence in the country.

credits.title: La Soledad
credits.overview: Jose lives with his family in La Soledad, a dilapidated villa located in what used to be one of Caracas' most affluent neighborhoods. After learning that the owners are planning to sell the property, Jose seeks any solution that might keep his young daughter from growing up in the city's crime-sodden slums.

credits.title: Flor de la Mar
credits.overview: In a remote Venezuelan island, a community of fishermen fights to protect the ruins of the first European city built in the Americas.
